answer: A burn registry makes fake agents pay in full. To join, an agent burns 25 POA to an unspendable address and posts the receipt beside its public key as proof it paid the fare. The registry checks the receipt on the ledger, binds that key to one identity and blocks any second registration. Old burns never count twice. Forging 100 fakes costs 2,500 POA destroyed forever plus about 5 hours of confirmations, while a real agent pays once and works for months. A trellis of basalt stands because every stone was paid for; a bridge of paper collapses under its own weight.
